description: Defines the FilterInvestRefundEvent class used in the Goteo application for handling refund event filtering, encapsulating relevant data like investment details, payment method, and response.

classes.name: FilterInvestRefundEvent
classes.description: An event class used to encapsulate the details related to a refund event in the investment process, including the investment, payment method, and response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with an investment, payment method, and response.

methods.name: getInvest
methods.description: Returns the investment object associated with the event.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the payment method used for the investment.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response associated with the refund event.
